holdings_fixed_term_complete.name: holdings_fixed_term_complete
holdings_fixed_term_complete.value: "holdings"."valuation_method" <> 'fixed_term' or ("holdings"."term_start" is not null and "holdings"."term_end" is not null and "holdings"."rate_percent" is not null and "holdings"."rate_period" is not null)

holdings_units_asset_required.name: holdings_units_asset_required
holdings_units_asset_required.value: "holdings"."valuation_method" not in ('fx', 'crypto') or "holdings"."asset_code" is not null
